disposition_reason: The registered endpoints quantify CA1/CA3 place-field shifts and mechanistic agreement of BTSP/STDP models, not an ordered predictive benchmark. Increasing slope significance, directional proportions or in-sample trajectory R² does not surpass the biological finding. The reviewed source does not establish a single original predictive-loss task; a new held-animal task would be an extension.

source_paper.title: Synaptic plasticity rules driving representational shifting in the hippocampus

evidence.supports: Mechanistic account of trial-by-trial place-field shifting in familiar/new environments.
Reused Dong et al. recordings, CA1/CA3 COM input files, separate optogenetics, figure-to-code mapping.

evidence.locator: 15-lap and 30-lap eligibility; animal assignments; COM conversion/centering and trajectory fits
evidence.supports: Original descriptive trajectory units, preprocessing and fits.

evidence.locator: Comparison CA1 vs best models; P(CS) dynamic models
evidence.supports: Slope distributions, directional proportions and mean-squared-displacement comparisons, without a recovered ordered held-out model score.

target.description: Describe familiar/novel CA1 and CA3 place-field center-of-mass shifts and compare their dynamics with STDP/BTSP mechanisms, including separate optogenetic effects.

dataset.description: Author-supplied CA1_COM_withPFs.mat and CA3_COM_withPFs.mat reuse Dong et al. 2021 recordings; optogenetic experiments are separate source materials.

cohort.description: Source assigns animals explicitly and groups fields by region/environment. The complete animal roster across reused recordings, optogenetics and model analyses is not authenticated by this audit.

split.description: Reviewed descriptive COM analysis fits observed trajectories; no source-held-animal predictive benchmark is defined for the registered endpoints.

inputs.description: Processed place-field COM trajectories, onset laps and source animal/environment assignments; model simulations supply mechanism comparisons.

preprocessing.description: Author analyses convert positions to centimeters, center at onset and apply trajectory support requirements (15 laps for selected analyses, 30 for specified displacement comparisons); linear/exponential fits and interpolation have distinct roles.

metric.description: Slopes, shift-direction proportions, trajectory R² and displacement statistics characterize data and mechanisms. There is no defensible uniformly ordered paper-win metric for these registered findings.

aggregation.description: Some original comparisons pool fields and others average animal summaries. These are distinct scientific estimands and must not be swapped to produce a larger effect.

comparison.primary_metric: No ordered performance metric for the registered place-field findings

published_baseline.description: Descriptive biological statistics are not source performance scores.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No author performance baseline applies to the descriptive registration; numerical COM reconstruction remains calibration.

minimum_effect.rationale: No ordered improvement endpoint exists for this registered descriptive finding.

uncertainty.independent_unit: Not defined for a paper-win comparison.
uncertainty.rationale: Descriptive confidence or significance is not algorithmic superiority.

paper_win_requires: This registration cannot admit a paper win while it retains only descriptive COM/mechanistic endpoints.
Reconsider eligibility only with an explicitly recovered original ordered model-performance endpoint, complete source cohort and comparator; do not silently create held-animal prediction.
Do not count better R², stronger P values, changed inclusion or larger shifts as superiority over the paper.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was performed; source-paper reproduction and source-author reruns are separate claims.

episode.improvement_loop: No active improvement loop is admitted for the descriptive registration. Preserve reconstruction and mechanistic review separately.
episode.candidate_freeze: Not applicable until a source-supported ordered task is recovered and reviewed.
episode.final_evaluation: No same-task superiority evaluation is currently defined.
episode.baseline_policy: The source COM/statistical pipeline is a calibration reference, not a performance rival.

blocking_issues: No source-defined ordered performance endpoint for the registered biological findings.
The original complete empirical/model/optogenetic scope is larger than the local bounded CA trajectory scorer.
A newly invented predictive split would change the question rather than surpass the original result.

legacy.notes: The registered-runtime METHODS.md explicitly defines numerical reconstruction of processed trajectories and separate error/coverage scores. Preserve all OLS/trajectory graders and evidence as calibration only; they do not test a mechanism or an algorithmic paper win.
